title: Deploy AWS Lambda functions with container image
description: This sample project demonstrates how to deploy an AWS Lambda function with a container image that gets triggered when a new object is created in an Amazon S3 bucket

introBox.headline: How it works
text: When a file is uploaded to a specific Amazon S3 bucket. The create object event from S3 triggers the AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function uses a container image instead of a zip file. The function reads the content of the file uploaded into the S3 bucket.

bullets.text: Deploy Python Lambda functions with container images

text: See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
Delete the Amazon S3 email bucket content: aws s3 rm s3://{SampleFunction} --recursive --region {your-region}
Delete the resources deployed to your AWS account via AWS SAM: sam delete
